Can I use Lem in the shower or bath?

Absolutely! Lem is waterproof (IPX7 certified), so feel free to take it with you into the shower or tub for some steamy, wet fun.

How do I clean and maintain my Lem?

Taking care of your Lem is simple and straightforward. You can easily clean it with a wet wipe for a quick refresh. After cleaning, make sure to dry it thoroughly before storing it in a cool, dry place.

Can I use lubricant with Lem?

Yes, you can! However, we recommend using a water-based lubricant for the best experience with your Lem. Silicone-based lubricants can also be used, but may damage the surface of the toy over time.

How do I charge Lem?

We've made charging your toy super easy and convenient for you. Your toy comes with a portable charger that snaps onto the back of your toy. Simply attach the other end into a USB port or adapter, and let it charge. Voila!
